description: This file contains the implementation of a weather service class (WeatherService) that generates deterministic pseudo-random weather forecast data for a specified city, number of days, and units (metric or imperial). The class implements the IWeatherService interface and provides methods for generating forecasts, including temperature, humidity, wind speed, and summaries.

classes.name: WeatherService
classes.description: A mock weather service implementing deterministic weather forecast data for testing purposes.

methods.name: GetForecast
methods.description: Generates a list of weather forecasts for a given city over a specified number of days, using deterministic pseudo-random data.

methods.name: HashToSeed
methods.description: Converts an input string into a consistent integer seed for random number generation.
